scores.notes: Jesus stands at the far end of the boat with arm extended over smoothing water under a dawn-lit parting sky; disciples crouch around the mast, with a lamp in the foreground and a torn sail above. No lettering, painted to every edge, hands and faces sound.

Samuel in a blue cloak tips a horn over the kneeling David in a sunlit Bethlehem courtyard, with Jesse (old man with a staff) and three brothers, one in armour, standing around. No glyphs or edge problems; the radiance over David is barely visible.

Viewed from inside the cave: Jesus raises his arm in the bright entrance, Martha kneels, the crowd stands behind and the stone is rolled aside, while wrapped Lazarus sits by a lit lamp at left. Deckled white watercolour edges (accepted); no lettering or anatomy faults.

Moses sits on a stone with both wrists held up by Hur and Aaron, the battle below; but in the middle-distance sand just right of Moses' robe hem (around x 790-930, y 400-470) are loops of cursive pseudo-script that read as handwriting. White paper edges are accepted; a spare unheld staff leans beside Moses.

Alice gestures to the floating Cat's head while the King hides behind her and the Queen and card soldiers stand in the distance, with a hedgehog at her feet; but the large playing card the King holds has a letter index (an 'A'/'K' glyph) in its top-left corner. White vignette edges are accepted.

Samuel in a blue cloak holds a horn over the kneeling, praying David, with a small glow at his head, in a stone courtyard with flat-roofed houses; five onlookers (Jesse, an armoured brother and others) stand around. One more bystander than the selected three brothers, but he reads as another brother; no lettering or anatomy faults.

Wide view of the tent camp, with the tabernacle in its white-curtained court at centre and a white cloud column rising from it as families gather bundles, donkeys and rope. The objects held in the foreground are blank; no glyphs or edge problems.

The father embraces his ragged, barefoot son on a stone road by olive trees and walls while two servants come in from the left with a folded robe and sandals. Hands and faces are coherent; no lettering.

Paul sits in a stone house-church with believers in a loose circle, a blank scroll on the bench beside him and the doorway showing Corinth in warm light. The shelf lamp is lit rather than unlit, which is minor; no glyphs or anatomy faults.

Chariots and horsemen charge down the dry sea bed between towering water walls, with Moses holding a staff at right and figures fleeing near him; a headless T-shaped fire and cloud pillar glows over the sea, with no face or limbs. The bottom-left corner fades to bare paper (accepted).

David has thrown the whole sling, which flies through the air with no stone striking, yet Goliath is already toppling sideways and backward with face up rather than falling on his face; spear and shield drop and soldiers watch from both slopes. The released-sling and hit-before-impact contradiction makes it incoherent.

Baker Street sitting room with the masked, fur-coated visitor holding his hat at the door and a beryl glint at his neck; but Holmes (seated left, gesturing with his pipe) is an unmistakable likeness of Benedict Cumberbatch from the screen adaptation. No legible lettering on the papers or clocks.

The father embraces his barefoot son in torn clothes on a village road while two servants come in from the left with a folded blue robe and sandals, a ring in the open palm. The robe border is vine ornament, not script; hands are sound.

Abraham and David flank a stone bench in a courtyard with jars, a wall and distant boats; but the scroll on the bench is open, not closed, and its exposed sheet carries several lines of script-like writing at centre. Watercolour white edges are accepted.

From inside the tomb, Jesus stands at the bright entrance with arm raised, calling, while Martha kneels with clasped hands, the crowd fills the foreground and the stone stands outside, and wrapped Lazarus sits up by a lit lamp at right. No lettering, painted to every edge, anatomy sound.

Holmes holds the blue stone to the window while Watson sits by the fire with an open strongbox on the desk; but Holmes is a Benedict Cumberbatch likeness (and Watson resembles Martin Freeman), and the desk papers show a heading and lines of script-like text. Light watercolour edges are accepted.

Golden rays descend over a fortified gate onto open storehouses full of jars and chests, while townspeople pass through and along the paved street. Wisdom appears only as light, with no figure; no lettering.

The walled city burns under streaking fire and sulphur from a dark smoky sky, with glowing bitumen pits and palms, while a lone herder in the foreground shields his face. Painted to all four corners; no gore or lettering.

Holmes flings a ball of papers toward the rack as Watson watches in a green-plush carriage; but the two are clear likenesses of Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman, and the newspaper at bottom left has a masthead and pseudo-text columns. White paper corners are accepted.

Moses with a staff points with an outstretched arm before a crowd of families, donkeys and sheep below a cloud-capped mountain, with tents beyond. Hands, children and faces are coherent; no glyphs or edge problems.

Young David crouches at the brook choosing smooth stones, with his crook, an open bag of stones and a sling in hand, while armoured Goliath approaches with a spear up the valley. A second bare stick leans by his arm; watercolour white corners are accepted; no lettering.

Holmes kneels on the flagstones with a lens and lantern while a sulking Merryweather sits on a crate with his stick in a vaulted cellar; but Holmes is a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness from the screen adaptation. No lettering on the crates.

God the Father is drawn as a white-bearded old man in robes seated on the central throne, against both the depiction rule and neverDrawn. The man-faced living creature (right of centre) has a photographic, pasted-looking human head on a winged robe with no coherent arms, beside the eye-covered lion, ox and eagle and John on the glassy sea.

Jesus sleeps peacefully on a cushion in the stern of the storm-tossed boat, but no one wakes him: the shouting disciples clutch each other amidships while others bail and haul ropes. The rousing in the scene and text is not shown; anatomy and edges are fine.
